thread:
jana (partnerships): Quick sync: Cloud marketplace listing + HW partner E2E validation + SI joint announcement. We need a checklist and blackout windows.
tom (hw-partner): HW partner needs a validation matrix: models, max seq len, perf targets, and expected infra (GPU type). we can run the kernel-level tests.
wei (marketplace): listing metadata we need: tile copy, pricing tiers, usage example, supported regions, permissable models (bundle vs api). deadline to upload assets: next Wed.
lucy (marketing): callouts: partners want a coordinated press embargo and a hero demo video. recommend a 2-week freeze for marketing assets before go-live.
gabi (solutions): from SI integrations POV: we need an installation guide for private deployments + a troubleshooting runbook. also sample terraform + helm charts.
jana (partnerships): propose phased go-live: 1) private beta (SI + HW validation), 2) marketplace tile soft-launch (no public announcement), 3) joint announcement week. Thoughts?
tom (hw-partner): ok. validation timeline: kernel perf tests (3 days), interoperability tests with gateway adapters (2 days), customer smoke test (2 days). total ~7 business days.
wei (marketplace): marketplace listing must be QA'ed in staging. can we get a staging tile and test harness?
gabi (solutions): I can provide a sample app that hits our gateway and a local adapter for SI installs. will instrument traces and add a smoke test script.
lucy (marketing): for announcement assets we need: blog draft, short demo clip (60s), partner quotes, one-pager, and social cards. target A/V pickup requires assets 10 days before announcement.
jana (partnerships): action items: tom -> validation matrix CSV by EOD, wei -> staging tile + upload creds, gabi -> sample app repo link, lucy -> draft comms timeline.
tom (hw-partner): sending CSV now. includes GPUs, driver versions, perf thresholds.
wei (marketplace): creating staging tile. drop creds in 1Password and ping me.
gabi (solutions): repo: github.com/redwood-inference/si-sample-app (private). will add runbook and smoke tests tomorrow.
lucy (marketing): drafting comms timeline. shall we target the week of May 12 for co-announce?
jana (partnerships): May 12 works if validation completes by May 2. any blockers?
tom (hw-partner): possible blocker: one GPU driver version fails an attention kernel test. I'll flag if we hit it.
wei (marketplace): note: marketplace listing requires legal signoff for co-branded assets. legal needs 3 business days.
jana (partnerships): ok adding legal review to timeline. also recommend a partner-ready changelog so SI teams know upgrade paths.
gabi (solutions): i'll add upgrade notes and compatibility matrix to repo.
deploy-bot: staging tile deploy started: job_5532. ETA 45m.
wei (marketplace): job_5532 succeeded. staging tile URL: https://staging.marketplace.redwood.ai/tile/si-hw-bridge
lucy (marketing): placing a placeholder in content calendar and requesting partner logos from Tom.
jana (partnerships): great work. we'll reconvene Friday 10am PT to review validation results and final assets. :calendar:
